summary.text: Vince Perez is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 77 who has served since January 14, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Republican Humberto Perez is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Vincent Perez, who is also known as Vince, earned bachelor's and master's degrees from Georgetown University, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists a prior office of El Paso County Commission Precinct 3, which he left in 2020, and says he succeeded Evelina Ortega in House District 77 when he assumed office in 2025.
He advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
